instruction: A dreamy cinematic medium shot captures a sunlit park path surrounded by trees, filled with a warm, hazy glow. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a light cardigan (R1) walks forward with a joyful smile. On the right, the blonde woman in a patterned shirt (R2) walks alongside her, smiling happily. The curly-haired woman and the blonde woman hold hands as they walk. Strong afternoon backlighting creates a prominent sun flare behind them, casting a soft, warm haze over the entire scene and softening the natural green colors.
